answer: Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique that blends information retrieval with large language models. A RAG system first queries an external knowledge base or document collection to fetch relevant passages, then feeds those passages into a language model so it can generate responses that are grounded in up‑to‑date or domain‑specific information.
